gloss: to display; to indicate; to show

definitions.gloss: to display; to show; to indicate
definitions.explanation: To make information visible or apparent, especially on screens, labels, signs, or instruments. Widely used in technology contexts for displaying data on a screen.

definitions.gloss: to express; to declare; to manifest
definitions.explanation: To openly show one's intentions, opinions, or feelings. More formal than simply saying or showing.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧ (surface, express) and {示|じ} (show, indicate). One of the most common words in technology and computing contexts, equivalent to English 'display' for on-screen content. Also widely used on product labels and in legal/regulatory contexts for required disclosures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{表示|ひょうじ}する: to display on screen
- ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{表示|ひょうじ}する: to display the price
- ⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧: labeling requirement
- 非{表示|ひょうじ}: hidden, not displayed
- ⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧{名|めい}: display name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧: to express, represent — broader; can mean expressing emotions or ideas, not limited to visual display
- ⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to show, indicate — more general; showing evidence, direction, or attitude
- ⟦{掲示|けいじ}→掲示：02838_keiji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to post, put up — specifically for posting notices or announcements on a board or wall
